source: sanitized Windows vendor-API sample-rate probe with live rejection and no-op write/read-back evidence

live_validation.procedure: stop all ASIO/WASAPI clients; read current and supported rates; only select a different device-reported value; read back; restore original; read back

attempts.result: 0xEE001002 TSTATUS_ASIO_IN_USE while an ASIO client was active
0xEE001004 TSTATUS_INVALID_SAMPLE_RATE after audio clients were stopped
success; no-op write read back as 48000 Hz

live_validation.result: setter ABI and current-value no-op write confirmed; real rate change blocked because the device reported no alternative supported rate

limitations: No actual sample-rate change was accepted; this fixture does not approve exposing sample-rate writes.
Changing sample rate may interrupt active audio clients, so the hardware test is explicitly gated.
The reason only 48000 Hz is reported in the current streaming mode is not yet recovered.
This validates the Windows driver API only and does not approve a Linux UAC2 SET_CUR request.
